UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile and smart autofill preferences for CivicTriage LSG.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID owning this profile document.

fullName.description: Full display name of the citizen or officer.

homeDistrictName.description: Display name of the home district/city.

abhaHealthId.description: Optional ABHA Health ID for hospital OP autofill.

academicStream.description: Optional academic stream for college admission and study planner autofill.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

UserVaultSection.title: UserVaultSection
UserVaultSection.description: Per-user isolated civic, travel, healthcare, education, and expense vault section serialized as JSON.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID owning this vault section.

payloadJson.description: JSON-serialized records for this user vault slice.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the vault slice was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the vault slice was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private per-user profile document isolated strictly to the authenticated owner.

/users/{userId}/vault/{sectionId}.description: Private per-user namespaced vault slices (tickets, bookings, OP slips, study plans, expenses, chat history).
